GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 fixes CVE-2023-54404 in zod 4.6.6. The remaining copy is zod 3.25.76, Studio's own catalog pin, also required by @hookform/resolvers 3.x, which reads ZodError.errors. zod 4 only provides .issues, so replacing that pin is a major upgrade. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.0 accepts zod ^3.25 || ^4.0, and its zod 4 copies are overridden to 4.6.6. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5
The advisory fixed release is Zod 4.6.6. Langfuse v2 is pinned to Zod 3.23.x; overriding to Zod 4.x breaks @langfuse/shared TypeScript compilation against upstream schemas.
